## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A test enforces that each principle file has its trigger, checkable bar and...

The system SHALL ensure that a test enforces that each principle file has its trigger, checkable bar and well-formed optional rule link, rejects one with no checkable bar, and rejects a rule link to an id not in docs/enforcement/rules.yaml.

#### Scenario: A test enforces that each principle file has its trigger, checkable bar and...

WHEN `inject-citable-principle-files-into-archetype-prompts` is implemented
THEN A test enforces that each principle file has its trigger, checkable bar and well-formed optional rule link, rejects one with no checkable bar, and rejects a rule link to an id not in docs/enforcement/rules.yaml.

### Requirement: Resolving an archetype with a principles list yields a system prompt...

The system SHALL ensure that resolving an archetype with a principles list yields a system prompt containing each principle's id and bar, and a size-budget test bounds the added text.

#### Scenario: Resolving an archetype with a principles list yields a system prompt...

WHEN `inject-citable-principle-files-into-archetype-prompts` is implemented
THEN Resolving an archetype with a principles list yields a system prompt containing each principle's id and bar, and a size-budget test bounds the added text.

### Requirement: A session-log decision citing a non-existent principle id fails validation

The system SHALL ensure that a session-log decision citing a non-existent principle id fails validation.

#### Scenario: A session-log decision citing a non-existent principle id fails validation

WHEN `inject-citable-principle-files-into-archetype-prompts` is implemented
THEN A session-log decision citing a non-existent principle id fails validation.

### Requirement: AGENTS.md indexes the principle files

The system SHALL ensure that aGENTS.md indexes the principle files.

#### Scenario: AGENTS.md indexes the principle files

WHEN `inject-citable-principle-files-into-archetype-prompts` is implemented
THEN AGENTS.md indexes the principle files.
